description: This file defines a custom exception class 'HttpTooManyRequestsException' within the Slim Framework, specifically for handling HTTP 429 Too Many Requests errors. It extends a more generic HttpSpecializedException and sets specific properties related to the 429 status code, message, title, and description.

classes.name: HttpTooManyRequestsException
classes.description: A specialized HTTP exception class representing a 429 Too Many Requests error.
